page_title: GET 0-2 RAY | Getafe v Rayo Vallecano 02/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
90' A wild pass somehow finds Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
89' The Rayo Vallecano players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
86' Francisco has decided to substitute Jorge de Frutos and he is replaced by Bebe (Rayo Vallecano).
86' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
84' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
82' What was Omar Alderete (Getafe) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
79' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) meets a cross inside the box, but David Soria wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
78' Borja Mayoral passes to Enes Unal (Getafe), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.
77' The substitution is prepared. Stefan Mitrovic joins the action as a substitute, replacing Djene (Getafe).
77' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
76' A long ball forward to Enes Unal (Getafe) is intercepted.
75' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) is caught offside!
75' Francisco decides to make a substitution. Sergio Camello will be replaced by Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano).
74' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging some short passes.
70' Unsportsmanlike conduct. Damian Suarez (Getafe) is shown a red card off the pitch!
69' The referee allows time for a substitution. Damian Suarez (Getafe) will be replaced by Omar Alderete.
69' The referee gives a yellow card to Damian Suarez (Getafe) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luis Milla (Getafe) departs the field of play to be replaced by Enes Unal.
69' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) walks off the pitch to be replaced by Carles Alena.
68' Flag goes up against Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
67' The current number of shots on goal is 0:7.
66' Rayo Vallecano take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
66' Damian Suarez (Getafe) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Free kick. Rayo Vallecano will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

65' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
64' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Getafe as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
64' Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Getafe. Let’s see what happens!
63' PENALTY APPEAL after Borja Mayoral (Getafe) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

59' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the right post, but David Soria pulls off a fine save to deny him.
59' Rayo Vallecano will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
59' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jose Angel Carmona comes onto the pitch for Jaime Mata (Getafe).
57' Substitution. Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) on for Unai Lopez.
56' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
56' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle and signals a foul after Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) brought his opponent down. Getafe earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
54' Jaime Mata (Getafe) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
53' The linesman signals that Jaime Mata (Getafe) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
52' Sergio Camello has a look up and finds Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post.

50' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez pulls out a red card and his decision is clear. Mason Greenwood (Getafe) is sent off for mouthing off and can take an early bath. The manager looks really angry for his irresponsible behaviour.
50' The ball is cleared after Mason Greenwood (Getafe) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
47' 0 - 2 Goal! Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 0:2. He was ably assisted there by Randy Nteka.
47' The attendance is 11204.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Francisco probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano). He is replaced by Pep Chavarria.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Francisco gives a chance to Randy Nteka and Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) is off.
46' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 0 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) and he fired home from close range. The score is 0:1.
45+1' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by David Soria.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The ball possession is 51:49.
43' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle after Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
40' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
38' Yellow card. Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
38' Luis Milla (Getafe) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

38' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The referee points to the corner flag and Getafe will take a corner.
36' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows the whistle, Damian Suarez (Getafe) is penalised for a foul.
35' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) picks up a rebound in space and tries his luck from long range, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
34' Luis Milla (Getafe) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
34' Diego Rico (Getafe) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Getafe will take a corner kick.
33' Luis Milla (Getafe) attempts to find Jaime Mata, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
29' Rayo Vallecano seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
27' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
26' David Soria somehow managed to stop a header by Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) from a rebound which would have ended in the bottom right corner. Rayo Vallecano get a corner.
26' A quickly taken corner by Getafe.
26' David Soria comes off his line to intercept the corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano). The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.

25' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom right corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert David Soria. What a save! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rayo Vallecano.

25' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) latched on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately slams the ball towards the top right corner. His effort was thwarted by the alert goalkeeper, who pulled off a stunning save.
23' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
22' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
19' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Djene (Getafe) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
19' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jorge Figueroa Vazquez no option but to blow his whistle.
17' Jaime Mata (Getafe) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
15' Getafe couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) leaped high and intercepted the cross.

15' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for an infringement. Getafe have a free kick from a promising distance.
14' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle and it's Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
12' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
11' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Some great controlled play and passing from Getafe. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just over the bar.
7' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for holding. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez signals a set piece.
6' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
6' Looks like Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
4' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
3' A pass from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by David Soria and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Rayo Vallecano will take the kick-off.
Jorge Figueroa Vazquez got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
